stories.title: Live: At least 47 killed after powerful quake shakes Colombia
stories.summary: At least 47 people have been killed in a major 7.4-magnitude earthquake that struck western Colombia on Monday, damaging buildings, trapping residents under debris and prompting evacuations in the capital, Bogota. The tremor was felt in other parts of Latin America, including Ecuador and Panama. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

opening: At least 47 people have been killed in a major 7.4-magnitude earthquake that struck western Colombia on Monday, damaging buildings, trapping residents under debris and prompting evacuations in the capital, Bogota.
The tremor was felt in other parts of Latin America, including Ecuador and Panama.
body: Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

More than a dozen buildings collapsed in aftermath of earthquake, which has also prompted evacuations People remain trapped in Cali, one of Colombia’s largest cities, ​after more than two dozen structures ‌collapsed, mayor Alejandro Eder said.
‌ He added that the city had asked authorities in Bogota and Medellin to send disaster teams ‌to support rescue efforts.
Quake of 7.4 magnitude collapses and severely damages buildings in several major cities, including Cali and Pereira Colombia earthquake live – latest updates.
The US and Colombian geological surveys reported that a 7.4 magnitude earthquake had struck at 7.34 am local time (13.34 BST) on Monday, with its epicentre in the western department of Chocó.
It was also felt in neighbouring Venezuela, which is still reeling from a deadly double earthquake on 24 June.
Emergency teams are still assessing the impact of the quake that was felt across the region.

stories.title: Ukraine drone strike on oil refinery deep inside Russia kills at least 13
stories.summary: Attack hundreds of miles from border would be among deadliest of war as Kyiv aims to strangle Russian economy A Ukrainian drone strike on an industrial city deep inside Russia has killed at least 13 people, according to the local mayor, as Kyiv steps up its campaign of long-range strikes on targets far from the frontline. Kyiv said it hit the Taneco refinery in the industrial city of Nizhnekamsk, around 1,200km (750 miles) from the Ukrainian border. The raid was part of a campaign to reduce the “military potential of the Russian aggressor”, Ukraine’s general staff said. Footage circulating online appeared to show smoke rising from the refinery in the city. Continue reading...

stories.title: Nearly 70 percent of France under water restrictions amid record heat
stories.summary: Nearly 70 percent of France is now under water-use restrictions as successive heatwaves and severe drought intensify pressure on the country’s water supplies. Authorities said Monday that 67 of 101 departments had reached the highest crisis alert, while two-thirds of groundwater reserves were below normal levels. Another heatwave is expected to spread across the country this week.
